page.features_heading: Easy enough for the classroom, capable enough for engineering.

features.title: Soluble support
features.text: Parts with hidden cavities and internal channels.

features.title: Front-panel interface
features.text: Manage print jobs at the printer.

features.title: Office-friendly
features.text: Quiet, GREENGUARD-certified operation with approved materials.

benefits.title: Easy to use
benefits.text: Simple to learn, operate and maintain.

benefits.title: Wide material range
benefits.text: From PLA to carbon-fibre ABS and TPU.

benefits.title: Small footprint
benefits.text: Fits an office, lab or shop floor.

specs.label: Material bays
specs.value: F170: 1 model + 1 support · F370: 2 model + 2 support

specs.label: Accuracy
specs.value: ±0.200 mm or ±0.002 mm/mm, whichever is greater (95 % dimensional yield)

specs.label: Materials
specs.value: F170: PLA, ABS-M30, ABS-CF10, ASA, TPU 92A · F370 adds PC-ABS, ABS-ESD7 and Diran 410MF07

specs.label: Support
specs.value: Soluble support (SUP706 on F370); breakaway available

specs.label: Software
specs.value: GrabCAD Print, GrabCAD Print Pro; Insight on F370

specs.label: Network
specs.value: Wired 100BASE-T Ethernet (TCP/IP), RJ45; wireless-ready IEEE 802.11 b/g/n; WPA2-PSK and 802.1x EAP

specs.label: Compliance
specs.value: CE (low-voltage and EMC), FCC, EAC, cTUVus, KC, RoHS, WEEE, REACH, RCM

page.applications_text: Concept models, functional prototypes and shop-floor aids without outsourcing.
